The '''Architect Droid AD''' was a model of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]-shaped [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droid]] produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] at the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. A number of them were used to defend the factory during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Architect Droid ADs appear as enemies in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where they can be found inside the Okara Droid Factory on the Imperial version of Balmorra.
